query:
INSERT INTO plant_molecules (plant_id, molecule_id, percentage, notes)
SELECT p.id, m.id, 
  CASE 
    WHEN m.name = 'Terpinen-4-ol' THEN 40.0
    WHEN m.name = 'Gamma-terpinene' THEN 20.0
    WHEN m.name = 'Alpha-terpinene' THEN 10.0
    WHEN m.name = '1,8-Cineole' THEN 5.0
  END,
  CASE 
    WHEN m.name = 'Terpinen-4-ol' THEN 'Composant majeur, propriétés antiseptiques'
    WHEN m.name = 'Gamma-terpinene' THEN 'Note herbacée citronnée'
    WHEN m.name = 'Alpha-terpinene' THEN 'Note fraîche'
    WHEN m.name = '1,8-Cineole' THEN 'Note eucalyptée'
  END
FROM plants p, molecules m
WHERE p.name = 'Tea tree' 
AND m.name IN ('Terpinen-4-ol', 'Gamma-terpinene', 'Alpha-terpinene', '1,8-Cineole');
